knowledge_point.title: Finding the Augmented Matrix of a Linear System With Variables Other Than x, y, z

question.:question/problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}9p-7q &=1 \\ 9p-7q &=-8\end{aligned}\right.
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
Notice that the system is already organized so that the variables are in the order $p,q$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient.

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
\begin{bmatrix}9 & -7 \\ 9 & -7\end{bmatrix}
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}9 & -7 & 1 \\ 9 & -7 & -8\end{array}\right]
$$

question.:question/problem:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}-10{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2} &=15{x}_{3} \\ -7{x}_{3} &=13\end{aligned}\right.
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},{x}_{3}$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}-10{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2}-15{x}_{3} &=0 \\ 0{x}_{1}+0{x}_{2}-7{x}_{3} &=13\end{aligned}\right.
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
\begin{bmatrix}-10 & -2 & -15 \\ 0 & 0 & -7\end{bmatrix}
$$

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}3a+11b &=6 \\ b-a &=c\end{aligned}\right.
$$

First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $a,b,c$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}3a+11b+0c &=6 \\ -1a+1b-1c &=0\end{aligned}\right.
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
\begin{bmatrix}3 & 11 & 0 \\ -1 & 1 & -1\end{bmatrix}
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}3 & 11 & 0 & 6 \\ -1 & 1 & -1 & 0\end{array}\right]
$$
